provenance: Independent exact algebra; not package execution or a sampling guarantee

two_way.interpretation: Finite inclusion-exclusion covariance may be indefinite; symmetrization alone does not make it positive semidefinite. This score pattern is not claimed as a fitted PanelOLS dataset.

calendar.interpretation: Equal observed-period lags and elapsed-calendar lags define different estimands for covariance; no claim that either is universally correct.
